intro: The estate is in Villamanrique, Campos de Montiel (Ciudad Real). From Madrid it is about 247 km and 3 h 25 min by car.
points: Address: Camino de los Collados, km 4,4, 13343 Villamanrique (Ciudad Real).
travel: By car from Madrid: 247 km, about 3 h 25 min.
Pickup in Madrid: Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas airport, Atocha station or hotel, on request.
We can coordinate a private-aircraft arrival and the transfer to the estate, on request.
Helicopter transfer with an authorised operator, on request.
docsNote: A Castilla-La Mancha shooting licence and compulsory insurance are required. You may bring a gun with a European Firearms Pass or hire a gun on the estate. We do not publish fees or processing times.
